verification_report.summary: Both frozen drafts are correct under the accepted smooth semipositive dual theorem. The divisorial argument validly turns a real Bott--Chern relation into a small positive-current perturbation and uses uniqueness to prove independence. The exponential argument correctly derives the uniform scalar estimate and barrier, identifies every L1 cluster through linear trace limits and local regularity away from Z, and therefore proves whole-family normalized L1 convergence. No capacity or uniform convergence across Z is inferred.
